cross_case_boundary: Missing public payer evidence is missing evidence, not proof that no cost or indemnity existed.
Insurance, indemnity, defense, settlement, procurement, and compensation remain separate financial objects.
Formal findings do not automatically establish personal culpability, legal liability, or a duty to pay.
Employment, police, bail, healthcare, detention, and custody remain separate causal and legal domains.
